imported_evidence: Two individually submitted research arrival forecasts and their published bounds, manually transcribed; auto-generated mean/median rows excluded
measured_evidence: None: arrivals remain forecasts as of retrieval, no PV telemetry or damage data imported
modeled_evidence: Union windows, sample counts and uncompressed telemetry bytes
synthetic_assumptions: SARM missing bounds replaced explicitly by 6/12/24 h planning buffers; computed midpoint baseline ±7 h; sample payload 256 bytes; cadence 60/600 s
units: UTC timestamps; bounds in hours; cadence in seconds; storage in bytes (decimal MB)
reference_frame: Earth-arrival forecasts, not spacecraft location or local radiation dose
rights: NASA-hosted factual forecast metadata with attribution to NASA M2M and UMA SARM; no article text, images, personal submitter details or model software redistributed; no upstream dataset license asserted
limitations: CCMC labels this experimental research information. Use NOAA SWPC for official forecasts. Missing bounds are not zero uncertainty. Model disagreement is not a probability distribution.
query: Pinned CSV through existing orbitalpv.data.load_table; offline reproduction
